title: Evaluation of an asPirin-free strategy with ticAgrelor in patieNTs witH a myocardial infarction treatEd medically alONe (PANTHEON)
official: Evaluation of an asPirin-free strategy with ticAgrelor in patieNTs witH a myocardial infarction treatEd medically alONe (PANTHEON)
summary:
Main objective: To evaluate if ticagrelor monotherapy is superior to Dual Anti Platelet Therapy for the risk of type 2, 3, or 5 Bleeding Academic Research Consortium (BARC) bleeding at 12 months
To evaluate if ticagrelor monotherapy is non-inferior to Dual Anti Platelet Therapyfor the risk of the composite of all-cause mortality, MI, stroke, or any coronary revascularization, a standardized patient-oriented ischemic clinical endpoint as defined by the Academic Research Consortium(6), at 12 months.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥18 years
2. Hospitalized for type 1 Myocardial infarction, according to the 4th Universal Definition of myocardial infarction
3. Coronary angiogram performed
4. Planned for medical management alone, without revascularization
5. Willingness to participate and to attend study visits
6. Expected life expectancy ≥12 months
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients hospitalized for type 2-5 Myocardial Infarction, or unstable angina, according to the 4th Universal Definition of Myocardial Infarction
2. Unsuitability for either randomization treatment, based on the judgement of the treating physician
3. Patients hospitalized for a ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction with an acute thrombotic lesion of a major epicardial vessel
4. Elevations in cardiac biomarkers (troponins or CK-MB) that is believed by the investigator not to be of ischemic origin (e.g. myocardial injury, myocarditis, Takotsubo syndrome, etc.)
5. Confirmed or suspected spontaneous coronary artery dissection
6. Concomitant indication for chronic oral anticoagulant
7. Concomitant non-coronary indication for dual antiplatelet therapy
8. Use of any non-trial antiplatelet drug that needs to be continued based on the judgement of the treating physician
9. Previous hospitalization for MI, PCI, or CABG within 12 months
10. Known hypersensitivity, intolerance, or contra-indication to ASA or ticagrelor
